Dear [Recipient's Name],  

I’ve had the pleasure of collaborating daily with Amira Benali at Nexu Games, a mid-sized startup focused on game development. As a peer, I’ve witnessed her consistently drive reliability and scalability across our systems.  

Amira’s strength lies in her ability to balance technical precision with pragmatic problem-solving. She owns our AWS infrastructure, refining it to handle peak traffic during game launches. When we scaled our player base by 40% last quarter, her adjustments to auto-scaling groups and load balancers prevented downtime. She also spearheaded a Terraform overhaul, reducing deployment errors by 50% and cutting manual configuration time by hours weekly.  

One standout moment came when a critical Kubernetes cluster failed during a live event. Amira quickly isolated the issue, rerouted traffic using Prometheus alerts, and restored service within 15 minutes. Her calm under pressure and deep understanding of our stack minimized fallout. She’s also a quiet leader—she mentors junior engineers on CI/CD best practices, ensuring our pipelines remain robust without micromanaging.  

Amira’s work ethic is unwavering. She’ll stay late to debug a tricky Prometheus metric or refactor legacy code to align with modern practices. Her attention to cloud cost optimization has saved the team thousands annually, and she’s always eager to share insights.  

In short, Amira is a reliable, proactive engineer who consistently elevates our operations. She’d be an asset to any team. Please feel free to reach out for further details.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
